subject: Insurance
title: Medicare for All Debate
description: A fast breakdown of Medicare for All Debate for builders.

hook.text: Medicare for All would replace private insurance with a single government plan.

buildup.text: Proponents say it would cover everyone, eliminate insurance bureaucracy.

discovery.text: The estimated cost: $32 trillion over 10 years. But the current system costs $52 trillion in the same period.

twist.text: The insurance industry employs 3 million people. Medicare for All would eliminate most of those jobs.

climax.text: Medicare for All is a math problem with a political barrier.

quiz.question: What's the main political barrier to Medicare for All?
options: It would eliminate insurance industry jobs and raise taxes
